payload.gloss: one unit of work in a plan, realizing exactly one concept, the one its pin names, which is among the concepts its plan realizes, and carrying its full spec and lifecycle state, which moves forward one step at a time. One live unit per name within its plan. Its dependencies are acyclic and name live units of the same plan. Readiness is computed, never stored: a unit is ready when every dependency has reached completion or moved past it and no owed ruling names the unit or its plan.
